scope: ONE selected fixture readiness query only, noUIcase/sync/writes
sql: SELECT ca.id,pu.project_id,ca.project_unit_id,ca.book_id,ca.chapter_number,ca.assigned_user_id,ca.peer_checker_id,ca.status,ca.has_conflict FROM chapter_assignments ca JOIN project_units pu ON pu.id=ca.project_unit_id WHERE ca.id IN (747,993,1184) ORDER BY ca.id;
